text:
Nina: quick proposal 1 pilot a 'stabilizer' role (48h) + mandatory follow-up-owner assignment within 2h of close. thoughts?
Omar: yes. stabilizer = monitors for re-fires and confirms actions get owners. avoids closed-but-unstable cases.
Gabi: suggest we require a 1-line closure rationale and list 3 likely re-fire alerts in the close flow. tiny friction, big payoff.
Rae: can we automate nudges? oncall-bot should DM follow-up-owner assignment reminders: 2h after close, escalate at 24h.
oncall-bot: Configured: will DM if no follow-up-owner in 2h; will escalate to channel at 24h.
Nina: communication cadence: during active P1 -> updates every 30m; stabilizer window -> summary at 6h and 24h, then daily. keep updates <=2 lines.
Omar: we also need a compact handoff template (single post) with fields: state, top actions (owner, ETA), open alarms, stabilizer end, links.
Gabi: for tracking, CSV table: action_id, owner, due, status, severity, incident_ts, recurrence_tag. auto-export weekly.
Rae: recurrence detection: group by error message + endpoint + deploy tag. weekly digest to service owners with top recurring signals.
Nina: propose remediation SLAs: critical/major/minor -> 10/30/90 days. we can tweak after pilot.
Omar: action items:
- Nina: write pilot plan + signup (due 3d)
- Gabi: make handoff template + close-flow quicklines (due 48h)
- Rae: implement bot nudges + CSV export (due 1w)
- Omar: spec recurrence digest (due 1w)
Nina: pilot 3 weeks starting next Monday. metrics: percent follow-up-owner assigned within 2h, overdue actions, recurrence trends.
Gabi: :thumbsup:
Rae: :thumbsup: will start wiring bot changes.
Omar: adding stabilizer duties to playbook PR now.
Nina: thanks all, will post pilot signup and runbook PR later today.
